answer: Proof of space resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated storage. When surveying a frozen tundra for an acoustic whisper or gentle zephyr, each node must solve unpredictable sector queries within tight deadlines using cryptographic disk plots. An attacker incurs the physical expense of provisioning persistent drive capacity per false identity. However, this approach privileges warehouse-scale datacenters and remains susceptible to time-memory trade-offs using fast GPUs.
